title: BJP MLA's private Innova washed by fire brigade, video goes viral

Traders express concern over mandatory packaging, while the FDA cites adulteration risks.  The FDA seized over Rs 5 crore worth of edible oil during recent inspections.

title: US embassies across the world to visa applicants: Your application is on hold

This initiative seeks to standardize how applicants are evaluated based on the potential for public charge implications. title: 1,500-year-old child burial unearthed in Peru with whistles, rattle and vessel
content: Archaeologists found a 1,500-year-old infant burial in northern Peru.  The child was buried with whistles, a rattle, and a sculptural vessel. Excavations continue to expand understanding of the Moche community.
